build_standard_decoder: build a StandardTransformerLMDecoder with decoder layers, layer normalization, and optional dropout
create_decoder_layer_hook: create a TransformerLMDecoderLayerHook protocol to intercept layer outputs during decoding
register_layer_hook: register a layer hook on TransformerLMDecoder to observe outputs after each layer computes
run_decoder_forward: run the forward pass of StandardTransformerLMDecoder on sequences with optional incremental state bag
compile_decoder_layerwise: compile each layer and layer norm of StandardTransformerLMDecoder individually for optimization
